economics.steering_rule: steering rule: if the probe's measured per-panel price does not undercut $0.039/panel, A is NOT scaled — its economics become an OPEN OWNER COST DECISION and B/C compete for the win
economics.honest_verdict: Pricing is FLAT per image (~$0.0389) regardless of panel size — the $0.0001 delta below 0.039 is rounding noise, not an undercut. A 4-panel page via per-panel generation costs ~$0.1556 vs $0.039 one-shot (4x). Per the steering rule A is NOT scaled this session; whether exact binding-by-construction is worth 4x image cost is an OPEN OWNER COST DECISION.
